title: Agent Learning Observation Recorded Event
description: Structured observation captured from agent execution for later episode synthesis

observation_id.description: Stable identifier for the normalized observation

agent_name.description: Name of the agent that produced the observation

session_key.description: Session identifier associated with the observation

decision_type.description: Decision or checkpoint being observed (e.g. search_before_create, verification_step)

task_tags.description: Task tags used for later retrieval and grouping

source_event_ids.description: Upstream event ids that justify the observation

tool_name.description: Tool involved in the observation, if any

verification_status.description: Verification state at the time the observation was recorded

failure_mode.description: Normalized failure class if the observation captured a miss

fix_applied.description: Brief summary of the corrective action taken

notes_preview.description: Redacted short preview of relevant notes or evidence
